title: General English — Level 1
instructions: Work independently without a dictionary or coursebooks. Read each instruction carefully. This is a course achievement exam; it does not certify a CEFR level. Speaking is assessed separately by your instructor. All cases are fictional.

A.title: A. Vocabulary in meaning
A.instruction: Choose a word from the word bank for each definition. Use each word once. Each item is worth 2 marks.

questions.question: the name people use to call you
a person you work with
a device used to call or message people
a home inside a larger building
a place where trains or buses stop
eat the first meal of the day
the work someone does to earn money
small grains cooked and eaten as food
red blue green and similar qualities
look at written words and understand them

B.title: B. Grammar and intended meaning
B.instruction: Choose the correct option. Where a meaning is specified, choose the form that expresses that meaning. Each item is worth 2 marks.

questions.question: My neighbours ___ friendly.
She ___ a new bag.
There ___ three chairs.
I need ___ umbrella.
He ___ at seven every day.
___ you work here?
We do not have ___ milk.
These ___ are blue.
She is ___ dinner now.
They ___ the room yesterday.

C.title: C. Reading
C.instruction: Read the passage and answer using evidence from the text. Each question is worth 4 marks.
C.passage: My name is Hana. I live in a small flat with my sister. There are two bedrooms and a kitchen. Our flat is above a shop, next to the library. I work in a café from Monday to Friday. I start at eight and finish at three. My sister studies in the morning. We usually cook dinner at home. I like rice and vegetables, but my sister likes pasta. On Saturdays, we visit our parents. Yesterday was Sunday. We stayed at home and watched a film. Today I am cleaning the kitchen, and my sister is reading in her room.

questions.question: Who lives with Hana?
Where is the flat? Give two details.
What time does Hana finish work?
What did they do yesterday? Give two actions.
What is Hana doing today?

D.title: D. Listening
D.instruction: Read the questions for one minute. Your coach will read the passage live twice. Write short answers. Each question is worth 4 marks.

questions.question: On which day is the class?
What time does it start?
Which room do students need?
What two things should students bring?
Who can help at the front door?

E.title: E. Writing
E.instruction: Write a message to a new classmate. Introduce yourself, describe where you live, give two details about your daily routine and say what you did yesterday. You may invent personal information.
